text_block_list.text:
It's unfortunate that I failed to win first
place, but
I must accept the outcome as
it is.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
There will inevitably be times where
even perfect
preparation will not
guarantee victory.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
But so long as I continue training
according to
this schedule, victory
should still be within reach.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш
choice_data_list: You did your best, and that's what counts!
Let's aim even higher next time!

text_block_list.text:

text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
I suppose. I certainly committed myself

wholeheartedly to this endeavor.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
So despite being unable to win first
place, it is
possible to say that I won the
battle with myself.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Of course! I have no intention of giving
up now.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
While these results are within the realm
of
expectation, I am not satisfied with
them.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
I'll need a well thought-out plan if I
hope to
achieve my goals.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
...Thank you for your support. I vow to
emerge
victorious next time.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Let's begin preparing for the next race
once we
get home.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш
